verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence of a user-facing export of all data in open formats. Graph API read and sync endpoints are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not an export feature. MIME support is documented only for sending mail. The libpst/readpst conversion of .pst files to mbox is a third-party, user-side workaround, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
